tagline: Turn cURL commands into idiomatic Java — stdlib HttpClient or OkHttp3
pageDescription: Free cURL to Java converter transforms cURL commands into production-ready Java using the Java 11+ java.net.http.HttpClient standard library or Square's OkHttp3. Emits HttpRequest.Builder fluent calls, try-with-resources where applicable, Base64-encoded Basic auth, and timeout configuration. Perfect for Spring Boot, Jakarta EE, or Android backends. Browser-based conversion means your cURL command never leaves your device.

proTips: Prefer Java 11+ HttpClient in new code — no extra deps
Use OkHttp when you need interceptors or connection pooling control
Share a single HttpClient/OkHttpClient instance application-wide
Set explicit timeouts — defaults are too permissive
Never disable TLS verification in production
troubleshooting: HttpClient not found: ensure Java 11+ target (pom/Gradle)
SSL handshake failure: verify truststore and TLS version
Connection pool exhausted: reuse the same client instance
Body not sent: verify -d or --data flags in source cURL
